title: The BEST night of the year- this is my third year in a row going and ...
transcript: My favorite night of the year, every year, without fail, is always the MCC Theater annual Miscast Gala, where all of your favorite Broadway stars get together and they sing songs from shows that they would never get to sing. I don't know how they do it, but every single year they somehow manage to top themselves from the year before, and this year was definitely no exception. I feel like this year was one of the most unhinged miscast we ever had. From Colescola singing a burlesque version of A Music Man skip track about our weather in July, to Megan Hilty and Jensen Mard singing the confrontation from Les Miserables in full costume. Men like me have never changed, men like you have never changed. No, they told us. We also had Anna Gasteyer come out in full wicked garb. But. But the song that she actually ended up singing made me laugh out loud. And of course, a whole lot of belting. A lot of beautiful, sincere performances, like Aaron Tveit doing a tribute to Gavin Creel, Phillipa Soo and her husband Stephen Pasquale doing a mashed up of songs from rent and Merrily we Roll Along. Nicole Scherzinger singing I am what I am. I know I say this every year, but I really do feel like this year was the best miscast they've ever done. And if you are sad that you missed it, great news for you, they're actually streaming it on YouTube! For free on April 21st.
classificationReason: Creator is reviewing an annual charity gala/concert event (MCC Miscast), not any specific stage production on the list. No matching show exists.
